दल् दलति pp. दलित (q.v.) burst, split, open (intr.).
C. दालयति & दलयति cause to burst, divide, tear or drive asunder.
—अव burst or fly open. उद् C. split, cleave, tear up. वि burst or
fly open;
 tear asunder, split.

†दाल v. र॑ज्जुदाल;
 f. दाला & दालिका colocynth.
दलन a. (f. ई) & n. bursting, splitting, crushing.
